turns.text: ok i need to vent for a second. literally. i live in one. 14 inches wide, industrial, smells like ozone and old drone coolant, and today NEKOCORP tried to bill me RENT for it.
hi, BRIK, ex-KILLDOZER operator, Demolished District — yes that's a real district name now, yes I named it myself, after the crew took my apartment down with me still inside doing laundry.

NEKOCORP's new pitch on the listing: 'efficiency micro-loft, exposed ductwork, some character.' my guy. I KNOW character. I used to flatten character for a paycheck. this is a vent. I pay zero dollars for it on principle.
invoice showed up anyway. 'occupancy fee, unregistered airspace.' I ate the invoice. not a metaphor. physically ate the paper. tasted like a warranty claim and regret.
